name: FIXED_MOMENT_HEIII_ENVELOPE
task_date_basis: KST research session date; evidence timestamps UTC
primary_question: At fixed initial gas, positive photon number N0 and mean energy on I=[13.61,24.58] eV, determine the exact attainable interval of initial HeIII epsilon^2 t^4 coefficients and its sign domains.
motivation: Quantify spectral information loss exposed by the PHYS23 same-N,U opposite-sign example.

constraints.measure: finite nonnegative photon-number measure, initial isotropic angle distribution independent of epsilon
constraints.N0: binary64 0.05 photon/H interpreted as exact real
constraints.probability: dP=dnu0/N0, integral dP=1, integral E dP=Ebar

conventions.coefficient: [epsilon^2] = one half second epsilon derivative; time coefficient has no additional factorial
conventions.geometry: B=t Sigma, Sigma=shear diag(1,-1,0), q=tr Sigma^2=2 shear^2
conventions.source_constants: exact-real interpretations of source binary64 literals, not native arithmetic emulation
conventions.log_energy_operator: D=E d/dE, C=D(D+3), D holds initial gas state fixed

kernel.existing_helper: PHYS23 response HeIII_t4_s-4 already includes q N0/45; never double-normalize

numerical_input.interpretation: Exact rational interpretation of serialized numerical decimals when constructing a mathematical certificate; underlying J physical/numerical uncertainty is not enclosed.
